title.evidence_quote: The SCDTP Selection Committee for entry in 2027/28 will meet in March 2027

description_short: The ESRC South Coast Doctoral Training Partnership, United Kingdom, invites applications for social science PhD studentships for 2027/28 entry. Applicants submit one form to the host institution and one to the SCDTP by 16:00 GMT on 15 January 2027; some partners set earlier deadlines.
